title: Cumbre Vieja eruption and Lyn Buchanan's warning

tellings.quote: And by the way, when it was going off, I was in communication with him being like, "Lynn, do you think this is it? Like, should I leave New York? I was in New York."

plain: When the Cumbre Vieja volcano on the Spanish island of La Palma erupted in 2021, the researcher Jason Jorjani says he was messaging a man named Lyn Buchanan, whose earlier warning the story turns on, asking, "Lynn, do you think this is it? Like, should I leave New York?" Jorjani tells it as something he lived through himself, since he was in New York at the time and took the warning seriously enough to ask whether the city was in danger.
